The Editor-in-Chief and Publisher raise concerns about the validity of the data: a reader alleged that authors Zhang H, Feng Y and Gu J had previously published the same results in Chin J Anaesthesiol. 2011;31(04):432-434 (doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.0254-1416.2011.04.012), and that the clinical trial registration number ChiCTR-TRC-11001791 cited in the article was taken from an unrelated study. Journal review confirmed the registered trial differs from the published study in age range (60-120 vs 18-72 years), indication (cognitive dysfunction in the elderly vs postoperative pain) and size (100 vs 72 participants), and that the number had been wrongly ascribed in the Methods as an ethics approval number. Two editorial board members compared the two articles but could not conclude with certainty that the data were from the same study. The authors and their institution did not respond to a request for an explanation and the raw data. The notice is not a retraction; the Editor-in-Chief alerts readers to reach their own conclusions.
